sources.name: UBC Okanagan Events Calendar
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] with title/description/venue/cost. Campus-wide (talks, workshops, student life), not international-student-specific, but Global Engagement Office and Student Services post orientation/newcomer programming here. Re-enabled 2026-09-09: the list-typed-venue bug that crashed parse_tribe() here was fixed in the shared builder on 2026-08-26 (same fix that unblocked UMSU in Winnipeg) - confirmed the fix is in place before flipping this back on.

sources.name: Okanagan College - International Education
sources.notes: Best-fit source (International Education Week, International Orientation for 550+ students/term). Drupal 9/10 JSON:API ('oc_events' module), found 2026-08-26 by reading the Angular app's own network calls - the URL above is the exact working, already-filtered request. New generic `okanagan_events` parser added 2026-09-09 (reads field_event_date_range / field_event_location_description, follows links.next.href for pagination) - confirmed working.

sources.name: Okanagan Regional Library
sources.notes: Runs on BiblioCommons (confirmed via page source 2026-08-26). A generic `bibliocommons` parser now exists (2026-09-09, unlocked Halifax and Vancouver's libraries) - but ORL's own tenant at orl.bibliocommons.com/v2/events returns 'Events (403 Forbidden): The Events feature is not available at Okanagan Regional Library.' This is a per-library configuration choice by ORL, not a platform or parser gap - confirmed genuine dead end, not just unparseable.

sources.name: KCR Community Resources - Immigrant & Settlement Services
sources.notes: Central Okanagan's main immigrant/settlement services agency - Volunteer Friendship for Newcomers, Community Connections, pre-employment and tax/tenancy workshops. Runs Event Espresso (confirmed 2026-08-26 via page network requests), REST namespace confirmed live at this URL. Activated 2026-09-09 using the existing parse_event_espresso parser - no new code needed, just flipping the kind.

sources.name: WorkBC Employment Services Centre - Kelowna
sources.notes: Provincial employment services centre with newcomer/immigrant-specific programming (Career Paths for Skilled Immigrants, YESS). WordPress site, no /events route found (404) 2026-08-26 - workshops likely announced via in-centre postings or a newsletter, not a public calendar.

sources.name: City of Kelowna Events Calendar
sources.notes: Drupal 7 site; the /rest/events path returns server-rendered HTML, not JSON, regardless of Accept header (confirmed 2026-08-26). An RSS feed exists at kelowna.ca/rss/events.xml (valid RSS 2.0) but no existing parser kind handles bare RSS - candidate for a small generic-RSS parser if this recurs. City also runs the 'Newcomers' resource hub page linked as home.

sources.name: Downtown Kelowna Association
sources.notes: WordPress site, wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not The Events Calendar plugin, custom events template instead. Runs the Thursday Night Market (May-Sept, ends Sept 3 2026) and Meet Me on Bernard programming - good social fit once a feed or reliable scrape point is found.

sources.name: Tourism Kelowna Events
sources.notes: wp-json/tribe/events route 301-redirects rather than returning JSON 2026-08-26 (openresty edge in front); aggregates festivals across the whole Central Okanagan including Center of Gravity and other major festivals. Worth re-probing the redirect target directly.

sources.name: Evangel Church Kelowna - ESL Ministry
sources.notes: Standing weekly ESL classes (High Beginner 9-11am, Intermediate 11:30am-1:30pm) explicitly for international/newcomer adults - contact esl@evangelkelowna.com. No dated feed, term-based standing program only. Left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Okanagan College - International Education (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Manual-kind twin of the okanagan-college probe source above, needed because build_board.py's parse_manual() only fires for sources whose own kind is 'manual' - a manual_events entry pointing at a probe-kind source_id is silently dropped (confirmed by testing; this also appears to affect the existing Kingston config's QUIC-sourced manual event, worth checking there too). Holds the one hand-verified dated item until the real Drupal JSON:API parser exists.

sources.name: Kelowna Gospel Fellowship
sources.notes: Runs on Planning Center's Church Center app, not a scrapable calendar platform we support. Included as a spiritual-stream candidate for hand-entry when a specific newcomer/international event is announced - no dated events confirmed yet 2026-08-26.

manual_events.title: International Education Week at Okanagan College
manual_events.venue: Okanagan College, Centre for Learning Atrium, Kelowna
manual_events.verify: Nationally BC International Education Week falls in the third week of November; exact 2026 daily schedule not yet published on Okanagan College's site as of 2026-08-26 - confirm dates/times before drafting.
